emotional_tone: Focused, motivating, nostalgic, ruggedly structured yet elegant.

headings.usage: Primary hero text, Level & XP indicators, Section Titles

subheadings.usage: Dense game text, secondary stats, dialogue boxes

body.usage: Data tables, checklists, body text, form inputs, tooltips

background.description: Deep stone slate mimicking mining depths. Subtle noise overlay recommended.

layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, but using p-6 or p-8 for internal card padding to ensure bento grid breathes.

grid_system.dashboard_mode: Control Room Grid. Base grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
grid_system.cards: Sub-components span 3, 4, or 6 columns based on importance.

structural_patterns.shell: Left Sidebar (w-20 md:w-64) with pixel-icon navigation. Main content area takes remaining width.
structural_patterns.hero_section: Col-span-12. Contains Player Banner, Level, Streak, and animated XP Progress Bar.
structural_patterns.study_zone: Col-span-12 lg:col-span-8. Pomodoro, Study Quests, Academic Graph.
structural_patterns.health_career_zone: Col-span-12 lg:col-span-4. Vertical stack for Health Tribute & Career Hub.

surfaces.card_style: Neo-brutalist / Voxel tactile style. solid background (bg-zinc-900), hard 2px solid black border (border-2 border-black), and offset block shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#000000]).
surfaces.hover_state: Translate slightly (translate-y-[2px] translate-x-[2px]) and reduce shadow (shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#000000]) to simulate pressing a physical block.
surfaces.glass_style: Banned. Do not use glassmorphism. Stick to solid blocks for structural honesty.

components.progress_bar: XP Bar style. segmented blocks or pixelated fill. bg-black container, bg-green-500 fill, border-2 border-black.
components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none), bold uppercase monospace text, block shadows. Primary action gets Diamond Blue or XP Green.
components.checkbox: Shadcn custom. 24x24px, square, border-2 border-black. Checkmark is a pixel art cross or standard check.
components.tabs: Blocky, rugged. Active tab appears pressed down or has a vibrant bottom/top border.
components.charts: Recharts with monospace fonts on axes, sharp right-angled lines (step mode) instead of smooth curves for the academic graph.

motion.micro_interactions: Instant, snappy. No slow fading. Mimic 8-bit game responsiveness.
motion.xp_gain: Number pop-up animations (e.g., '+50 XP') floating up and fading out.

image_urls.description: Dark aesthetic study/coding desk setup. Use as a potential hero background or Career Hub header with an overlay.
Computer setup in a forest with a smiley face. Indie game/pixel vibe. Use for Health/Tribute Zone header.
Vibrant dark space/nebula. Use for Meditation Timer background or 'Deep Focus' mode.

specific_features.hero_dashboard: Display an overarching Level, XP Bar, current rank (e.g., 'Novice Engineer'), and streak flames.
specific_features.study_quests: A nested accordion or list using checkbox inputs for JEE Physics/Chem/Maths. Each check awards XP.
specific_features.pomodoro: A blocky, digital clock style timer. When active, dim the rest of the UI slightly.
specific_features.health_tribute_zone: Grid of tracking cards: Health Condition Meds (alert color: Redstone), Food Time Buddy, Yoga Nidra toggle, Wim Hof tracker, Skin Issue log. Uses toggle switches or custom checkboxes.
specific_features.career_hub: Mini-dashboard tracking daily video edits (counter), clients (counter), and a LinkedIn external link button.
specific_features.ai_buddy: A persistent or toggleable chat panel in a dialogue-box style (think RPG NPC conversation box). Used for Claude 4.5 tips.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, checkboxes) MUST include `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="quest-checkbox-physics"`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over the dark backgrounds meets APCA standards. Use primary white/off-white for body text.

instructions_to_main_agent.frameworks: React, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Recharts, Lucide Icons (or Phosphor Icons/Pixel Icons if preferred for game feel).
instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install `lucide-react` or `react-icons` for game-style icons. Use `sonner` for XP/Achievement toasts.
instructions_to_main_agent.custom_css: Add custom utility classes in tailwind config or index.css for the neo-brutalist shadows (`shadow-pixel: 4px 4px 0 0 #000`) to apply them cleanly.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import 'Silkscreen', 'VT323', and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts.
